comment: Run on the instance via SSM to ferry benchmark results to S3. Replace <STATE_BUCKET> with your state bucket name (kept out of the repo).
commands: for f in matmul.png cnn_training.png speedup.png matmul.json cnn_training.json; do aws s3 cp "$f" "s3://<STATE_BUCKET>/benchmark-results/$f" --region us-east-1; done
